WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, si.entrystat,
         AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_gb,
         AVG(s.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.memusagegb > 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_of_site_avg_ram_gb,
       AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: A zero CPU value makes the GPU-to-CPU ratio undefined, so that row is ignored for the ratio average; AVG also ignores missing values.
